firstPlayerRule: Black always moves first. Each player chooses one colour to use for the whole game.
houseFallback: If both players want the same colour, flip a coin to choose.
clarifications: The game always begins with two black and two white discs in the centre.
internalEvidence: Read the World Othello Federation English official rules in a browser. "Each player takes 32 discs and chooses one colour to use throughout the game." Rule 1: "Black always moves first."
uncertainty: The rules do not say how players choose colours.
